question:
Select the figure from the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d42dc87f961e3e03a71244aa15ede88da0186c020b74cd4cd3981d95a7655fdb.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Step I: L is shifted one place in the next boxes.**

**Step II: One new symbol is added in each boxes.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3e171ee5bb9bbfa72f2fe45b8630d33013dd4b5c144b7938463508e30d79eb1.png] **

So, Option 2 will complete the series.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
